title: Add unit coverage for console screenshot
description:
## Why
`kbs console screenshot` shipped via PR #178 with Gherkin coverage, but develop has no Python unit tests and no Rust `mod tests` for the capture helpers.

## What
Port salvaged unit tests from the closed side branch `cursor/cli-board-screenshot-5624` onto current develop:
- `python/tests/test_console_screenshot.py`
- Rust `mod tests` in `rust/src/console_screenshot.rs`

Adapt for develop env hooks (`KANBUS_TEST_SCREENSHOT_NODE_EXECUTABLE`, script search override, hide package script).

comments.author: ryan
comments.text: Ported unit tests onto develop on branch feature/console-screenshot-unit-tests. Deleted stale remotes: cursor/cli-board-screenshot-5624, cursor/cli-board-screenshot-plan-5624, cursor/console-screenshot-main-3bba. Tests passing locally; awaiting commit/PR.
